"'''Cantham Cellar'''" was the codename for a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]]. The prison was built on an [[Unidentified island (Cantham Cellar)|island]] and was run by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
